opening.argument: The presentation urges viewers toward New Degen Order as an NFT drop to mint while expressly tying that purchase to “huge gains that will explode.” It reinforces that promotional framing by calling the project “Fantastic project to watch out for” and describing a future holder-related mechanism in which below-floor listings face variable 33–77% royalties based on DAO voting. Yet the reward, its implementation, and any resulting outcomes are not established. The warning that viewers “could lose your entire investment” acknowledges risk, but it does not resolve the pairing of requested NFT participation with unusually large-gain claims.
